1158963132183851008.a: After much thought, I think one reason #makerspace fund raising efforts fail is that we forget why people make. Funders are all "hoorah! job creation! " but that's not what people need. People need hope, food, healthcare (eg usable prosthetic), clothing, etc before a job matters.

1158963677002907648.a: How do you teach someone to run a 3D printer who can't read? How do you teach someone anything if they have no food in their brain? Learning skills is a waste of time/money until the people you teach are healthy enough to think.

1158964257700143104.a: Teach them to make a garden, make food, make utensils, make a shirt or jacket, make anything meaningful to them...before you even start talking about how to improve skills for work. Because those things set baselines you need to gain skills. Hopeless, starving people can't learn.
